LOOK: Metropolitan Manila Development Authority  General Manager Usec. Nicolas Torre III, with Valenzuela City Mayor Wes Gatchalian oversee the conduct of Bayanihan sa Estero at the Kalabingkoho River in Barangay Malanday, Valenzuela City, on Thursday, January 22.

The activity involved clearing garbage and silt from a two-kilometer stretch of the Kalabingkoho River to improve water flow and reduce flooding, which often affects communities along the Valenzuela–Meycauayan boundary when rising water obstructs the river’s passage toward MacArthur Highway. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
